raw_graphql_pull_request.body: issue：https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/39700 base pr：https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40333 ## Summary The DeepSeek V4.1 CP prefill indexer introduces host synchronization when uploading CPU metadata and indexing the request-to-token table with a CUDA scalar. These waits prevent the CPU from submitting subsequent work asynchronously. - Upload query lengths and key offsets through the existing pinned-memory, non-blocking transfer helper. - Keep request indices as one-dimensional CUDA tensors to avoid implicit device-to-host scalar reads. - Add a regression test that rejects CUDA scalar reads during mixed-length prefill, including requests with zero query tokens. ## perf --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :x: [Run #35436933948](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35436933948) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #35436933799](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35436933799) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #35436933971](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/35436933971)
